isolation_policy: bubblewrap mount namespace: only the workspace, the policy-accepted read allowlist and the opencode runtime exist; the repository, the other arms' results, the earlier sessions and the global opencode configuration (its MCP servers and plugins) are not mounted; plus the opencode v2 permission object (bash denied, edit and write denied, read and external_directory deny-by-default with the explicit allowlist)
limitations: The mount namespace is the filesystem guarantee; the model provider is reachable over the shared network, so a model that was shown a file can still send it away.

generative recommender's semantic IDs. A program has already checked that the code
runs: the geometry contract, the candidate's own tests, the export/assignment
agreement and a two-rank DDP run. Do not re-check those; judge the MECHANISM.

THE RESEARCH OBJECTIVE:
The level-1 code must predict which level-2 code the next item carries. BRad-RQ sets each item's tangent radius from the rank of its training context entropy and assigns codes with the Poincare kernel, so the radius decides the code. The hypothesis is falsified by a single Stage 3 run: test_R@10 not above 0.065.

/fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research/issue121/trees/round_20261029_093253_576/BRad-RQ

Answer these three questions, each with a verdict of PASS or NEEDS_FIX:
